reason: I hate the hours I spend typing openers, so the idea is tempting, and $147 isn't the problem. But my Instagram is where my clients come from, and I'm not putting it behind a Chrome extension that sends for me when nobody has published a single result.
objection: Will this get my Instagram restricted or banned? 'Human pace' and 'no password' are not a promise, and if my account goes, so does my main source of clients. With zero customer results and 7 seats taken, I'd be the guinea pig, and a 3-day trial is too short to see replies or a ban risk anyway before the card gets charged with no refunds.
would_change_my_mind: Real coaches or agency owners at my level showing months of use on their own accounts with no restrictions and actual booked calls, or a longer trial or a refund window so I can test it on a throwaway account first.
